name: Nee, Amaete! ~Futari no Ane to Mi mo Kokoro mo Torokeru Seikatsu~
original_name: 姉、あまえて！ ～2人の姉と身も心もトロける性活～
source:
After both our parents passed away from an accident, my older sister, Saya became a worrywart.
It reached to a point where I thought she was being overprotective and was spoiling me.

One day, my eldest sister, Kayano came back from abroad after a very long time.
After seeing how her sister and brother lived, Kayano was at a loss for words.

"Saya! You're spoiling Kouta way too much! He won't ever be able to be independent like this!" was what Kayano said to us.

Right, that's what I also thought...
The angry Kayano made Saya stop spoiling me and had me be independent.
This was when the meddling (in various ways) of my two sisters started.

Saya, the older sister who could not stop being overprotective and kind towards me...
Kayano, the older sister who was strict but also kind towards me...
Living with my two beautiful sisters, the days became lively and fun.

...If it's like this, I wonder if I'll ever become independent..?

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=874114]Getchu[/url]]
